title: Scenario cards, capacity calculator vignette, and SLA timeline visuals for Dedicated onboarding
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a compact set of onboarding visuals for Dedicated capacity that guide users through three decision scenarios (steady throughput, bursty/autoscale, and regulated slow throughput), an interactive capacity calculator vignette for the quickstart flow, and a high-contrast SLA timeline asset for the Console release notes and in-product help.
deliverables: 3 scenario decision cards (desktop + mobile breakpoints) with progressive disclosure
Animated capacity calculator vignette (SVG prototype, accessible fallback) showing how pool size, batch size, and quantization affect cost and latency
SLA timeline visual: clear outage/fallback ladder + SLO targets across Dedicated tiers (Standard, Premium, Enterprise)
Microcopy pack: tooltips, CTA variants, and fallback CTAs for capacity shortfalls
Developer asset bundle: Figma frames, export-ready PNG/SVGs, spec tokens, and localisation notes
acceptance_criteria: Scenario cards render correctly at 320px, 768px, and 1440px with readable typography and iconography
Capacity calculator prototype responds to input knobs and demonstrates at least 4 realistic customer examples (low, medium, bursty, regulated)
SLA timeline has contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text and key indicators, and includes explicit fallback behavior descriptions
Microcopy approved by PM and Engineering and reviewed for localization (EN/FR/DE/JPN)
Assets exported and uploaded to company Figma library and product-assets bucket with clear naming conventions
tasks: Design: create stationary and animated variants of the capacity vignette
Design: craft three scenario cards with icons and short outcome statements
Copy: draft tooltip and CTA copy for each scenario (3 variants) and provide alt text for all images
Accessibility: run contrast check and keyboard/voiceover walkthrough on prototypes
Handoff: generate spec tokens, spacing grid, and export delivery to engineering
progress_updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff workshop with PM/Eng. Agreed on three customer scenarios and primary SLO buckets.
2026-03-03: First-pass mockups reviewed — requested stronger visual distinction between autoscale and reserved steady-state.
2026-03-07: Accessibility pass completed; updated color tokens to meet contrast target; awaiting microcopy review.
2026-03-10: Prototype animated vignette uploaded to Figma and internal review scheduled for 2026-03-12. Preparing export bundle.
decisions: Use scenario cards as the primary selection surface in the quickstart flow instead of a long form to reduce cognitive load.
Animated vignette will default to motion-reduced static variant for users with reduced-motion preference.
SLA timeline will include an explicit ‘fallback ladder’ showing routing to compatible model variants and cross-region failover.
notes: Keep assets modular so PMs can reuse the scenario cards in docs, marketing one-pagers, and the Console. Include clear naming for localization keys. Coordinate with Infrastructure team for up-to-date latency/cost figures used in the vignette examples.
